application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Variation of Conditions 2 and 3 to vary approved drawings and materials to reflect alterations to the ground floor shopfront and to the design and materials of the top floor roof extension following permission 00248/342-344/P13 dated 21.10.2019 for demolition of existing second floor and erection of a mansard roof extension with rooftop plant following demolition of existing second floor and conversion of the upper floors to form four residential units with new entrance door, associated amenity space and cycle storage, and flexible use of the ground floor and basement as Use Classes A1 (Retail) and A3 (Restaurant).
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before 21 October 2022.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (E50 Rev. A, E51 Rev. A, E52 Rev. A, E-53 Rev. A, P50 Rev. A, Revised Design and Access Statement August 2019, Heritage Statement April 2019, Energy Statement August 2019, Planning Noise Assessment April 2019, Planning Statement August 2019. Received: 02/09/2019. P100 Rev. H, P101 Rev. G, P102 Rev. F, P111 Rev. D, MMA - Materials schedule. Received: 24/12/2020. P110 Rev. G. Received: 14/02/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The commercial floor space shall be used for A1/A3 purposes and for no other purpose (including any other purposes in the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), or in any provision equivalent to that Schedule in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for A1/A3 purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times: 07:00 - 23:00.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the development hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with Planning Plan November 2019 - Rev 0, C8-1 Rev P2, C8-2 Rev P1, C8-3 Rev. P3, Document C8-4 approved as part of planning application 00248/342-344/P13(8,16).

Condition : 8 - Before the dwellings hereby approved are first occupied, the developer shall provide secure covered cycle parking stores in the location shown on the approved plans for not less than three bicycles. The approved facilities shall conform to the Transport for London 'London Cycling Design Standards' in design and layout.

Condition : 9 - (A). Development shall not be occupied until a scheme for the storage and collection of waste and materials to be recycled has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

(B). Development shall be occupied until the waste and recycling facilities approved under Part (A) of this condition have been provided and made available for use. Such facilities shall remain throughout the lifetime of the development and shall be used for no other purposes.

Condition : 10 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with Energy Statement Issue 3 December 2019 approved as part of planning application 00248/342-344/P13(2-15) and shall not commence above ground until full Design Stage calculations under the Standard Assessment Procedure have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local planning Authority to show that the development will be constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Condition : 11 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.
Condition : 12 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with Energy Statement Issue 3 December 2019 approved as part of planning application 00248/342-344/P13(2-15).

Condition : 13 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved internal water use calculations.

Condition : 14 - (1) The development shall be carried out in accordance with Document C15 approved as part of planning application 00248/342-344/P13(2-15).
(2) The building(s) shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 15 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with Discharge of Planning Condition 16 prepared by Anderson Acoustics dated November 2019 approved as part of planning application 00248/342-344/P13(8,16).
